title: atoll capacity --json
description: What the pool can hold with 1, 2 and 3 copies of every file, from the catalog alone (specs.md §13.1, §13.3). Bytes are of files: a file of 1 MB at 3 copies takes 3 MB of disks and counts 1 MB.

spread_mode.description: [placement] spread_mode: with strict, the formula is that of failure domains.

copies.description: k, the copies of every file: replicas + 1.

theoretical.description: The formula of §13.1 over the disks the solver can write to, data disks online or in standby, each its capacity less min_free.

reachable.description: stored, and the formula over the free space a plan that wants k copies of every file leaves on those disks, less min_free. That plan moves no copy, so a user copy stays where it is.

stored.description: The bytes of the files that reach k copies in that plan.
